explanation: It is 0 almost everywhere and fires only at the GO step when the agent chooses a1 again right after the previous trial a1 led by a rare transition to S2 and was rewarded. It reaches about 10 when the trial before that was also a rewarded a1 to S1 common, and about 5-9 when that earlier support is weaker; it stays 0 if the agent switches to a2, if the rare trial went unrewarded, or at any D1 or D2 step.
